Later, during these two years my follow up on the symptoms and requests do more check were resisted often by other male staff members. One time I spoke to a senior doctor and ask him to explain the blood test, he did not know how to explain them so I asked to be referred to a specialist who can help me understand why my body in not settled until now, he shouted on the phone: no, will not refer you.
